data.name: NinjaCat
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the world of NinjaCat!

This is a 3D action game unlike anything you’ve seen before.

You’ll take control of a NinjaCat and progress through the game.

At its core, it’s a simple third‑person 3D action game.

Your feline ninja can slash with a sword and throw shuriken!

Slashing objects will trigger various reactions in the environment.

Other actions include jumping and grabbing objects.

With Jump, you can climb to different places and explore new areas.

With Grab, you can carry key items to different locations and activate mechanisms.

Using these abilities, you’ll gradually explore the map and solve puzzles.

Once you’ve solved all the mysteries, you’ll clear the game.

Slash everything around you and move forward on your adventure!
